On Tue, 2026-11-22 at 15:05 Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Team — looping infra and finance to confirm numbers for ACME (ACME-3492).
> Proposed timeline in the spreadsheet (attached) — please review and reply with your sizing and any constraints by EOD Monday 11/24 so we can respond to procurement.

Folks — reviewed the spreadsheet and ran a quick capacity sketch with the model assumptions Priya noted (8k context, opt-quantized). Short version:
- Pilot (weeks 1–4): reserve 6 dedicated v4-like slots (estimate ~0.9 p99 headroom for 120 concurrent sessions with caching + batching).
- GA month 1 (ramp): plan for 18 dedicated slots with burst capacity available to 30 slots via ephemeral pools (if we allow cross-customer burst).
- Lead time to lock dedicated pool and reserve hardware: 10 business days to confirm and schedule validation runs.

Constraints / risks:
- If we need strict single-tenant GPU (no bursting to ephemeral), GA demand would require ordering additional reserved capacity which has a 3–4 week ops lead time.
- The target latency p95 < 350ms is achievable with batching + KV caching; need to scope prefix caching for their app patterns.

Attachments: fleet_estimate_nov22.pdf (pdf, 75KB) — capacity sketch and unit-cost delta by scenario.

Action items:
- Ben: finalize slot count and unit-cost for both pilot and GA (deliverable: updated estimate by 11/25).
- Laura: provide pricing options (pilot-reserve vs. 3mo commit) by 11/25 so Priya can share with procurement.
- Markus: validate any infra gating (networking/VPC peering) that would block private deployment.

Ben Carter
